tagline: 奥林巴斯数码单反相机，2007 年发布
description: 奥林巴斯于2007年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable (Four Thirds System)。快门速度1/8,000 to 60 s computerized focal plane shutter。

specs.传感器: Four Thirds System 18.00 × 13.50 mm Live MOS
specs.快门速度: 1/8,000 to 60 s computerized focal plane shutter
specs.闪光灯: built-in pop up flash GN=13 at ISO 100, wireless control for up to 3 external flash groups and 4 channels
specs.取景器: Optical TTL with pentaprism 100% field of view and ×1.15 magnification
specs.屏幕: 2.5" 230,000 pixel TFT LCD on full articulating multi-angle screen with live preview
